messages:
Haley (CS): quick sync — Acme's renewal is up 2026-05-01. PO owner says they'd like a 12-mo term, increase seats 50 -> 60, and need an updated quote and PO instructions by EOD Friday. any legal or pricing caveats?
Jordan (Sales): noted. they want monthly invoicing to match their procurement cadence. is that doable?
Maria (Finance): monthly invoices ok but need to confirm billing address and remit instructions. also flag: if we move to 12-mo with monthly billing, we need to confirm revenue recognition rules — can do but might ask for purchase order number up front.
Haley (CS): PO owner is lisa@acme.com. she can provide PO number once she has the official quote.
Tom (Legal): 12-mo term no problem. need to check T&Cs for seat addendum and prorated mid-term seat increases. will confirm if our standard amendment language covers the seat bump.
Jordan (Sales): pricing ask: they want to keep current unit price but add 10 seats. i'll propose we hold list price and apply 3% loyalty discount on the seat delta for the full year. ok to surface?
Maria (Finance): 3% discount on the 10 new seats looks fine if sales confirms list price stays. need to include a line-item: 
```
Seat price (existing 50): $800/mo each
Seat price (additional 10): $800/mo each - 3% discount => $776/mo each
Total monthly: (50*800) + (10*776) = $40,000 + $7,760 = $47,760
```
Haley (CS): perfect — i'll pass that to lisa. also they asked about signature flow: can we do DocuSign?
Tom (Legal): DocuSign ok. we'll prepare an amendment and include the PO number field. i can draft and send to esign-bot for envelope creation.
Rachel (Enablement): heads-up: seat increase means they want onboarding sessions for the additional team. Haley — want me to schedule a 2-hr kickoff + ramp plan?
Haley (CS): please do. target week of 2026-05-10. i'll coordinate attendees.
Tom (Legal): drafting amendment now. will include: 12-mo term start 2026-05-01, seat count 60, pricing as discussed, monthly invoicing, PO number required, standard refund policy unchanged.
Haley (CS): lisa replied: "thanks — need the quote + payment instructions by Fri. PO will be started as soon as quote received."
Jordan (Sales): i'll assemble the quote PDF and include the monthly invoice instructions. Maria — which banking details should we give for wire vs ACH?
Maria (Finance): send both. use billing@redwood for remittance email and our standard ACH + wire details doc link: https://pay.redwood.example/ach-wire. include contact: billing@redwood.example for any payment questions.
Tom (Legal): amendment ready. sending to esign-bot to create DocuSign envelope.
esign-bot: Envelope created (env_0c9a). Recipients: lisa@acme.com (signer), Jordan (cc), Haley (cc). Expected expiry: 30 days.
Haley (CS): sending quote + DocuSign link to lisa now. will post update here when PO lands. :thumbsup:
Jordan (Sales): thanks team. if we get PO before EOD Friday we can bill starting May 1. if any delays flag here and i'll follow up with the buyer.
Haley (CS): update 45m later — lisa acknowledged, asked whether seat provisioning happens immediately after signature or after first invoice. (she prefers immediate).
Tom (Legal): provisioning policy = immediately after fully executed amendment. that's standard. i'll add a clarifying line in the email to lisa.
Haley (CS): final note — tracking to close: Quote + DocuSign sent (1815003001), awaiting signature (expires in 30 days), PO pending. next check-in here tomorrow morning.
Jordan (Sales): +1.
Rachel (Enablement): scheduled onboarding hold for week of 2026-05-10, will populate calendar once we get final headcount and attendees.
